widgets_values: A curly-haired boy sits at the dining table eating an apple. His expression is focused and calm. As he slowly chews, the camera gently zooms out. The boy squints his eyes with a satisfied smile and tilts his head up. The background transitions from a real dining room to a dreamy pink-purple fantasy space. Floating flowers gently spin behind him. The scene becomes soft, warm, and full of a fairytale atmosphere.
